title: Technical Writer I
description:
The Technical Writer is responsible for preparing articles and other supporting documents to communicate complex and technical information to a diverse internal and public audience.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Work with and learn new technology as it emerges
* Dig deep into web hosting trends and share that knowledge with a diverse audience
* Determine the needs of end users and tailor technical documentation to meet those needs
* Work with technical staff to make products easier to use and thus need fewer instructions
* Write and review documentation for products
* Gather and apply feedback from customers, technicians, and developers
* Revise documents as new products and information emerges
* Ensure technical verbiage is easy to understand by the layperson
* Prepare charts, graphs, or forms to go along with rough drafts
* Adjust copy to match company style
* Understand how AI consumes and uses documentation on the internet
* Use AI to assist in preparing and revising documentation drafts
* Use project management software to help prioritize incoming work and company projects
* Participate in the incident management process as required to support overall issue resolution and system and/or service restoral

#### **Requirements**

* Knowledge of each of the components of the LAMP and WIMP stacks
* Working knowledge of cPanel/WHM and Plesk
* Basic familiarity with various CMS's and what they do
* Functional knowledge of WordPress & HTML
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, well-developed problem-solving skills, and a fine eye for detail
* Strong organization skills and ability to establish priorities
* Ability to move quickly and respond to on-demand projects

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in English, journalism, technical writing, library science or related field
* A passion for web hosting technology
* Strong technical savvy, the ability to quickly learn new technology as it becomes available
* High degree of discretion, full awareness of, and sensitivity to all Intellectual Property matters, documents and communications

title: Content Editor
description:
No Virtual Interviews, Applicant should available to attend the written test at our Kottayam office Kerala.

If job offered, H/She should be willing to commute or relocate at Kottayam

**Job Overview**

An Editor job opening for an IT company that publishes news in the English language, which is meant for the public at large. responsible for providing linguistic support to writers.  
**Responsibilities:**

* Edits and/or proofreads manuscripts and other forms of copy for publication, making stylistic, structural and grammatical corrections, as well as other substantive changes as needed
* write headlines, standfirsts (brief introductions) and photo captions.
* see that the report is in good language and there are no mistakes. There can be spelling mistakes, mistakes in sentence construction, grammar and factual mistakes.
* The sub editor then has to find a good heading for the story. The heading should be sharp, attractive, crisp and convey the spirit of the story. The heading should compel the reader to stop and read the whole story.
* Maintains contact with author, Freelance content writer, staff and others directly concerned with the published work, following through on specified requests and tasks.

**Requirements:**

* At least two years of experience in Editing.
* Freshers are also welcomed
* Fluency in written and spoken English
* sound knowledge of grammar, punctuation and spelling
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications
* Experience in writing, proofreading and technical/language editing of literature.
* Master Graduate in Literature/ Master in Journalism.

Send us your resume right away if the above job description excites you and your skill sets match our requirements!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Attestation Documentation Executive
description:
Duties \& Responsibilities

* Handle document attestation, apostille, embassy legalization, and related documentation processes.
* Verify documents and ensure they meet the required guidelines and submission requirements.
* Coordinate with clients for document collection, verification, and processing.
* Prepare and organize documents for submission to embassies, government departments, and concerned authorities.
* Track applications and follow up to ensure timely completion and delivery.
* Handle client queries related to attestation and documentation procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of documents, applications, and client details.
* Make regular calls and follow\-ups with existing agencies and business partners.
* Maintain good relationships with existing agencies and identify opportunities for repeat business.
* Identify and approach new agencies, travel companies, and potential business partners to develop new business opportunities.
* Explain attestation services, procedures, and pricing to agencies and clients.
* Follow up on leads, quotations, and pending requirements to convert enquiries into business.
* Achieve assigned sales and business development targets.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth processing of confirmed orders.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure the safe handling of clients' original documents.

Requirements \& Skills

* **1–2 years of relevant experience in attestation/documentation services is required.**
* Previous experience in **attestation, apostille, embassy legalization, or related documentation** will be preferred.
* Strong **sales and business development skills**.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to make regular calls and follow up with clients and agencies.
* Experience in **agency handling and relationship management**.
* Ability to generate new leads and develop new agency partnerships.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Office**.
* Ability to maintain lead sheets, sales reports, follow\-up sheets, and other Excel records.
* Good follow\-up, negotiation, and convincing skills.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated approach.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple clients and documentation processes simultaneously.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
